Russian helicopter briefly violates Polish airspace, NATO scrambles jets

Poland's army reported that a Russian military helicopter violated its airspace for approximately 42 seconds. The incident occurred near Braniewo, close to the Kaliningrad exclave. In response, Poland scrambled its fighter jets. The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) member country lodged a complaint with Russia.
